title: Aaja Abbas Veeran
body:
Aaja Abbas Veeran
<<DIVIDER>>
Daivay Saada-e-zainab (x2) Tori Na Aas Veeran.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Turr Gayan Jadon Da, Nay Chain Dil Nu Aunda
Nay Mangda Koyi Paani, Nay Baal Koyi Ronda
Asghar Tay Sakina Di (x2) Bhuj Gayi Ay Pyaas Veeran.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Wafa Da Jag Toh, Ghazi Na Koyi Sani
Ro Ro Kay Keh Rahi Ay, Dariya Di Ay Rawani
Teray Laahu Bhujayi (x2) Karbal Di Pyaas Veeran.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Man Tay Main Veeran Vich Karbala Day Aaye
Aj Maan Ay Tutt Gaya Ay Tu Day Gaya Judayi
Tu Kaar Gaya Ain Sari (x2) Duniya Udaas Veeran.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Di Qamar Vi Teray Bajoun Jhuk Gayi Ay
Bachda Nay Mera Parda, Haar Aas Mukhgayi Ay
Tu Kaar Gayan Ay Sari (x2) Duniya Udaas Veeran.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Lash Tay Main Veeran Sir Nangay Aa Gaye An
Mumtaz Khaimay Sarday Aatay Chadaran Na Rahiyan
Muk Nasal Gaye Karbal (x2) Aaya Na Raas Veeran.
